prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high, except for the pet companion redesign where the prediction was too low.
Redesigning the grid view pet companion was helpful.
Reordering the onboarding flow to narrative-first performed significantly worse.
Deferring sign-in after adoption showed no clear effect.
Adding hints, shortcut guides, desktop notification prompts, or tip carousels showed no clear effect.
Simplifying the path choice layout showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +17.5% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -8.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Photo Quality Validation Stage: Insert a new photo validation screen immediately after photo upload to verify image clarity and pet outlines before custom generation. (why: Support reported 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or resulted in distorted graphics, causing adoption stalls.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Spawn Test Stage: Add a dedicated desktop render test screen right after waiting to confirm the pet window displays properly on screen. (why: Support received 3 emails where pets failed to show on the desktop or the app stalled upon launching to the desktop.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Audio Notification: Add an audio completion chime and explicit notify toggle on the waiting screen when companion generation finishes. (why: The waiting screen has an exceptionally long mean duration of 2336s (nearly 39 minutes) as users tab away.)
3: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Character Selection Split View: Switch the character selection screen layout to split view featuring side-by-side animated companion previews. (why: Adoption target step conversion drops to 73.1% with long decision times during pet selection.)
4: [finish, hint] Finish Step Desktop Visibility Status Banner: Add a highlighted status banner to the home intro screen detailing how to locate and activate the desktop companion overlay. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not displaying on desktop and 3 tickets asked how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen adds friction; evidence comes mainly from support rather than the funnel.
Extra test step increases flow drop-off with low confidence of positive impact.
Funnel clearly shows extreme 39-minute wait time; wait_info changes previously yielded +3.5%.
Adoption redesigns previously showed strong +17.5% lift and target step has high drop-off and duration.
Finish step has highest drop-off and strong support evidence, but hint changes historically showed negative or no effect.
